values.quote: deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at 250 against epic monsters

mechanics.claim: Enemies stunned by Sejuani are marked Frozen for the disable's duration, and her next basic attack or ability against a Frozen target consumes the mark to deal the bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies {{tip|stun|stunned}} by '''Sejuani''' are marked ''Frozen'' for the disable's duration. '''Sejuani's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} against a ''Frozen'' enemy will consume the mark

mechanics.claim: Icebreaker does not trigger if the basic attack is blocked or misses due to blind.
mechanics.quote: ''Icebreaker'' will not trigger if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}} or misses due to {{tip|blind}}.

mechanics.claim: Frost Armor grants slow immunity and cripple immunity in addition to bonus armor and magic resist.
Gaining Frost Armor does not remove any pre-existing slows or cripples.
mechanics.quote: Gaining ''Frost Armor'' does not remove any pre-existing {{tip|slow|slows}} or {{tip|cripple|cripples}}.
